title: Months Given Back for Waiver Review — Benefit Overpayment Accounts Training Bulletin
content:
Months spent under waiver review on Benefit Overpayment Accounts, when billing stopped, are given back when the installment of a current repayment plan is changed. They are counted in whole months from the latest waiver request date to the handling date and added to the changed-plan months.

| Whole months from the latest waiver request date to the handling date | Months given back |
|---|---|
| 2 or more (the long-review months) | 2, the long-review extension |
| 1 or more but fewer than 2 | 1, the short-review extension |
| Less than a month, or no waiver request | None |

## Questions answered

**Which date is the latest waiver request date?** The date received of the waiver request lodged on the overpayment with the latest date received.

**Does the decision on the request matter?** No; the count runs from the request date to the handling date.

**Hypothetical cases.** With a latest request received on 10 March: handling date 10 May gives two whole months and 2 months back; 9 May gives one whole month and 1 month back; 9 April gives less than a month and none.
